links.comparator_used: Preliminary group: patients alerted in the first 6 months after implementation, compared with the SRP group from the second 6 months (propensity-matched, same NEWS alert system and 24/7 rapid response team)
links.outcome: 30-day mortality (secondary: blood culture ordering/performance and sepsis bundle compliance)
links.effect: 30-day mortality 25.0% (44/176) vs 15.3% (27/176); HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.36-0.86; P=0.017). Blood cultures 58.5% vs 45.5% (P=0.019). Antibiotics within 6 h 94.6% vs 88.3% (P=0.065). Survival benefit began to appear after about 4 months.
links.quote: The SRP group showed a lower 30-day mortality risk (hazard ratio, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.36-0.86; P=0.017) compared to the preliminary group.

design_hint: EHR alert-triggered sepsis response protocol with 24/7 rapid response team
